mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, conditions are clear at Badger Prairie County Park. We are currently under a new moon phase, and tonight's low will reach 39 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is progressing with phase two of the Mark Drive Reconstruction project. Recent work includes installing new water mains, sanitary and storm sewers, and laying down curbs and sidewalks. Please note that road work remains weather dependent.

Today you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are plenty of activities including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and the Wednesday pizza and pitcher special at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they found a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel. The individual was taken into custody for an O W I, first offence.

The flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The Verona location is currently open but will be closing in 55 minutes, so make sure to get there soon if you want to grab a scoop before they lock the doors for the night.
